newsitem.title: USA: Swift sets its largest fleet conversion.
newsitem.headline: Swift sets its largest fleet conversion.

text.p: Swift Transportation Co Inc said an agreement with a Baxter International Inc subsidiary will result in Swift's largest private-fleet conversion to date.

The company said it expects revenues from the agreement to exceed $5 million annually for "over-the-road" transportation of products from Baxter's El Paso, Texas, manufacturing facility to the company's customer-facing warehouses.

The agreement will continue with Allegiance Healthcare Corp when it and its parent, Allegiance Corp, spin off from Baxter later this month, Swift said. Allegiance is America's leading provider of healthcare products and cost management services to hospitals and other healthcare providers.

The agreement was designed to reduce Allegiance's transportation costs through operational efficiencies and a revenue-sharing program between the companies. Much of Allegiance's over-the-road trucking already is managed by third-party companies. Allegiance will continue to operate its own customer-delivery fleet.
